ground_truth_source: DARPA TC Engagement 3 Evaluation Ground Truth Report (SPAWAR/MIT-LL)

campaign_scenarios.name: Browser Extension Phishing & Local Payload Execution
campaign_scenarios.verified_source_facts: Victim user navigates to malicious URL hosting modified browser extension. Extension drops shell script dropper.sh to /tmp, which executes payload_x86 connecting back to C2 socket 128.55.12.91:8080.
campaign_scenarios.attack_vector: Malicious browser extension download and execution of local dropper
campaign_scenarios.uncertainty_notes: Ground truth boundaries strictly locked to report timestamp ranges; no surrounding-window label extension. Unverified IOCs excluded from confirmatory labels.

campaign_scenarios.name: SSH Password Compromise & Kernel Privilege Escalation
campaign_scenarios.verified_source_facts: Adversary conducts brute force authentication against sshd service on port 22. After successful credential login, adversary deploys shared library exploit /tmp/exp.so targeting local kernel CVE to spawn root_shell and read /etc/shadow.
campaign_scenarios.attack_vector: Brute force SSH credential access followed by local kernel exploit
campaign_scenarios.uncertainty_notes: Authentication events mapped 1-to-1 with SSH audit session tokens. Unverified IOCs excluded from confirmatory labels.

campaign_scenarios.name: Nginx Web Shell Persistence & Document Exfiltration
campaign_scenarios.verified_source_facts: Adversary injects malicious PHP web shell into Nginx document root via HTTP POST vulnerability. PHP-FPM executes system commands, invokes curl/powershell to stage documents and exfiltrate over TLS socket 198.51.100.42:8443.
campaign_scenarios.attack_vector: PHP web shell injection into Nginx web root with staged HTTP exfiltration
campaign_scenarios.uncertainty_notes: Exfiltration data volumes strictly cross-referenced with packet byte counters. Unverified IOCs excluded from confirmatory labels.
